The difference is almost entirely in missing carbon dioxide. What happened?

Life happened. Life formed and used what was most easily found - carbon. Carbon dioxide dissolved from the atmosphere into the ocean water, which was then used by plankton like the tiny diatoms. They built shells out of calcium carbonate. And when these creatures died, their heavy shells sank to the bottom of the ocean floor, forming thick layers that over many, many years became rock like limestone. That sequestered a huge amount of carbon from the atmosphere.
